dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); uses ORCMCPSUB call interface and COPY copybooks typical of the ORCA/GnuCOBOL environment

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/レセプト) system — inpatient (入院) labor accident (労災) accounting sub-program
purpose.summary: This subprogram calculates and assembles inpatient accounting data for labor accident (Rousai) insurance claims within the JMA ORCA standard receipt software. It reads inpatient accounting master records, inpatient action tables, and system management tables to derive fee reductions and additions, then returns results via a linkage area.

notable_features: 16 COPY statements for shared copybooks (CPNYUINACCT.INC, CPPTINF.INC, CPHKNCOMBI.INC, etc.)
16 CALL statements including ORCMCPSUB database access interface
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA and ORCSROUNYUIN-AREA parameters
OCCURS 31 table for day-by-day inpatient tracking
REDEFINES usage for date and code fields
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP database layer
High comment ratio (31%) with Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments
